items.title: Anne Phillips interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 24, 2025
items.q: Artie some years ago said, “You know, remember how dumb we used to think some of those songs were? Today they sound like Mozart.”

ctx.x: It’s funny, Dick Hyman made a comment at the time playing some of those pop tunes and they would joke about, “Just think, in twenty years people were saying, ‘they’re playing our song.’” And he says and they were. That’s what happened.
Yes. It was funny, Artie Butler — do you know Artie?
